note: Single source of the security headers of the sites this repository serves (deploy/headers.mjs turns it into nginx snippets and into what tests/csp-f0.mjs serves). Elffuss Link spec §4.4. Placeholders: {self} = the site's origin, {inline:<file>} = the sha256 sources of that page's inline scripts. Policies are chosen by path like an nginx map on $uri: exact paths, then regexes in order, then default.

policies.name: app
policies.why: Code itself. Scripts only from this origin (third-party code vendored in web/vendor/third-party/ and web/vendor/elffuss-ai/, Monaco included) plus WebAssembly; the one inline script is the import map, by hash. Frames: this origin (the HTML preview and the game checker in /sandbox/), the model stores (models, m1, m2: js/runtime/model-broker.js frames the one of each weight host), Claw's memory store, the extension sandbox (x2.utopiaia.com) and the SoundCloud player. Connections: this origin (/proxy, /websearch), the model hosts, Hugging Face, GitHub and Bitbucket (clone, skills), Open VSX (extensions), the API providers of Settings, the local bridge (127.0.0.1:8765, HTTP and WebSocket) and a model server on this computer. COOP same-origin-allow-popups: Code does not talk to an opener.
csp: connect-src 'self' data: blob: https://models.elffuss.com https://m1.elffuss.com https://m2.elffuss.com https://huggingface.co https://*.huggingface.co https://hf.co https://*.hf.co https://api.github.com https://raw.githubusercontent.com https://api.bitbucket.org https://open-vsx.org https://openvsx.eclipsecontent.org https://api.openai.com https://api.anthropic.com http://localhost:* http://127.0.0.1:* ws://localhost:* ws://127.0.0.1:*
frame-src 'self' https://models.elffuss.com https://m1.elffuss.com https://m2.elffuss.com https://claw.elffuss.com https://x2.utopiaia.com https://w.soundcloud.com
reportOnly: trusted-types elffuss-ai amdLoader standaloneColorizer editorGhostText domLineBreaksComputer editorViewLayer diffReview stickyScrollViewLayer tokenizeToString diffEditorWidget defaultWorkerFactory monaco-editor 'allow-duplicates'

policies.name: lab
policies.why: The test bench (lab.html): the same as the app, plus blob: modules (it imports the fixed SWE file to run its test). Its game arena is in /sandbox/ like the preview.
csp: connect-src 'self' data: blob: https://models.elffuss.com https://m1.elffuss.com https://m2.elffuss.com https://huggingface.co https://*.huggingface.co https://hf.co https://*.hf.co https://api.openai.com https://api.anthropic.com http://localhost:* http://127.0.0.1:*

headers.Permissions-Policy: camera=(), microphone=(), geolocation=(), usb=(), serial=(), hid=(), bluetooth=(), midi=(), payment=(), display-capture=(), browsing-topics=()

policies.name: eval-worker
policies.why: The worker where code.run evaluates an expression on a module of the project and where code.edit's syntax guard parses (web/js/tools/eval-worker.js). A worker's policy is the one its own response carries: this one may evaluate and import the page's blob: modules; it has no DOM and the page stops it by time.

policies.name: sandbox
policies.why: The page the HTML preview, the game checker (rlm.js) and the lab's arena are written into (web/sandbox/run.html, js/sandbox-frame.js). The `sandbox` directive gives it an opaque origin even when opened on its own. What runs there is what the project or the model wrote, as before (a srcdoc frame had no policy at all), and it cannot reach Code's storage or files. Only Code frames it.
csp: sandbox allow-scripts allow-forms allow-modals allow-popups allow-downloads

headers.Permissions-Policy: camera=(), microphone=(), geolocation=(), usb=(), serial=(), hid=(), bluetooth=(), midi=(), payment=(), display-capture=(), browsing-topics=()

policies.name: x2-vendor
policies.why: The level-2 extension bundle, fetched by the extension sandbox on its own site (x2.utopiaia.com): no page policy, CORP cross-origin.

policies.name: none
policies.why: Backends with headers of their own (/proxy answers with its own sandboxing CSP).
